name: Gluteus Medius / Minimus Tendinopathy
definition: Load-related tendinopathy of gluteus medius/minimus, a major cause of lateral hip pain and often part of greater trochanteric pain syndrome.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is used for persistent symptoms or suspected tear.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection or surgery is selective for refractory confirmed pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Snayu phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Load-related tendinopathy of gluteus medius/minimus, a major cause of lateral hip pain and often part of greater trochanteric pain syndrome.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
